beats.narration_text: Liam, in for Bear — the last part of the Musinique logo. Card flip, shadow play, composer summon, and three exits back to back. Everything after the entrance: how a mark holds space, how it shows its depth, and how it knows when to go.

Let's recap with Claude. Card flip reveals a second face at ninety degrees. Shadow play animates independently — it stretches ahead, snaps back. Composer summon types the mark into existence in the Claude UI. Then three exits, back to back: shrink-spin, blur-out, mask-close. The exit is the last vote.

Your turn. Paste this: build me three exits for my logo — shrink-spin, blur-out, and mask-close — and tell me which one matches a music brand that wants to feel like it still exists after it's gone. Exit is the last thing the audience remembers.
Musinique logo, in motion. Part five. All twenty. Liam, in for Bear.
